race.description: Ausure Insurance - Rose Davies Legend Mile Hcp (Bm78)
race.comment: AMREEKIYAH (3) returned from a 137-day spell with an impressive win in midweek company last start, coming from next to last to get the cash over 1400m at Warwick Farm. Back in great order and was competitive at this level last prep. Great chance to go back-to-back. CUBAN CIGAR (5) was gallant in defeat last start, lumping 62kgs and only missing a famous win in the Four Pillars by the barest margin. Drops 4kgs and gets an extra 100m today which looks perfect. Poses a huge threat. HAMMOON SENSATION (9) made it two from two this prep when he took out the Coonabarabran Cup at Dubbo a fortnight ago. That form should hold up at this level. The last run of POISEN POINT (12) is not as bad as it seems. Fitter now and cannot be ruled out.
